name: usage-pacer
description: Pace Claude Code's weekly usage limit day by day for the projects you choose: a side project is paused once the account runs ahead of its daily share, so your main work keeps its budget

daily_percent.title: Daily share of the weekly limit (%)
daily_percent.description: Paced projects may use at most day_of_week * this many percent of the 7-day window. 14.3 = the week split evenly; lower it to keep more for unpaced work.

block_tools.title: Also stop a running turn
block_tools.description: When the limit is crossed mid-turn, deny further tool calls and abort the turn. Off: only new prompts are blocked.
